verdict.rationale: The quickstart has you create a first feature flag in the Admin UI and connect an SDK. Activation strategies let you enable or disable features without redeploying, and per-environment toggles separate dev/test from production. A hosted instance is available, so no self-hosting is needed to start. Missing for 10: evidence of the 'within minutes of signing up' time-to-value claim (signup-to-first-toggle flow), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the onboarding speed.
